label: Diagram 3.2
caption: Diagram 3.2 Refuge formed in a protected stairway
description: This is a plan (top view) of a protected stairway. In the upper left corner the note "See para 3.5" appears. The stairwell is bounded by heavy black walls and contains two flights of stairs, shown as sets of parallel tread lines, arranged in a switchback. On the upper landing at the top left is a green shaded square with a dashed border containing a wheelchair symbol; this is the refuge. To the right of the green square, a grey semicircular area overlaps the end of the upper flight and the landing; it is marked by a curved arrow, with straight arrowheads at the ends of the two flights, indicating the escape flow. At the lower left, two doors with swing arcs open into the well, and a break line below indicates the plan is cropped. To the right, a note reads "Provision where access to the refuge is counter to the access flow within the stairway." Below it, a key shows a green square containing the wheelchair symbol labelled "Wheelchair space" and a grey square labelled "Occupied by escape flow". A green banner at the bottom reads "Diagram 3.2 Refuge formed in a protected stairway".
